name: Survey tile in Taurus
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 2.0 degrees north of the ecliptic in Taurus, imaged by SPHEREx 23 times in 8 visits over 67 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 45 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 2.8 days starting 2026-03-02, at wavelengths from 0.75 to 4.78 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
